title: Chicken Catalana
description: A classic Spanish dish of chicken cooked in a sweet and tangy sauce made with honey and crema.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the glazed chicken broth, honey, and smoked paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil and cook until the sauce has thickened slightly, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the crema and catalana sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top.
